risk.summary: Crisis VIX (418.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 12 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for PNW.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (50/200 EMA/SMA bullish) + extreme fear sentiment (26/100) + price near support (64.73) create contrarian setup for mean reversion.
